tunnelDown: {agent}'s computer is not connected — it is probably asleep or not started yet.
appOk: The app answers and the page is loaded.
appReady: The app answers and the page reported ready.
appSilent: The computer is connected, but the app does not answer; it may have exited.
appRestarted: The app just restarted; following the new instance.
appReconnecting: The connection dropped and is reconnecting; the loaded page stays on screen.
unknown: The link before this one is down, so this one cannot be checked yet.
